method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type, byte-length and content-hash checks; page-level review of Neoen offer and disclosure PDFs; direct Brookfield and SEC review for acquisition terms and the later syndication

verifiedClaims: As of December 31, 2025 BGTF II and passive co-investors held approximately 85.4%, Temasek through Rosa held approximately 14.1%, and senior management held approximately 0.5%
Brookfield completed its approximately 53.12% block acquisition on December 27, 2024, followed by the March 2025 tender and April 2025 squeeze-out
Neoen had 6.8 GW operating and 1.5 GW under construction at December 31, 2025; the Americas had approximately 0.9 GW operating across ten projects and contributed 12% of revenue and EBITDA
Fox Coulee in Canada was 93 MW and El Llano in Mexico was 375 MW, for 468 MW of explicitly identified operating North American assets
Neoen Limited is the UK parent guarantor and Neoen France S.A.S. is the former Neoen S.A. operating group
Brookfield announced negotiations on May 30, 2024 to acquire approximately 53.32% at EUR39.85 per share
The offer implied EUR6.1 billion of equity value
The acquisition consortium included Temasek but the special-purpose vehicle was exclusively controlled by Brookfield
Brookfield pursued the transaction through BGTF II with Brookfield Renewable Partners as cornerstone investor
Temasek held a minority interest in Holdco through Rosa Investments
Brookfield controlled the acquisition chain and Rosa entered a Holdco shareholders agreement
After settlement-delivery the offeror and concert parties held 97.73% of Neoen shares
They held 100% of the 2020 OCEANEs and 95.76% of the remaining 2022 OCEANEs
A Brookfield Renewable affiliate syndicated a 1.63% Neoen interest to a Brookfield Fund in the second quarter of 2026 for approximately EUR160 million
The disclosure does not establish a sale of control or a Neoen company exit

exitSearch.result: No company-level sale or Brookfield/Temasek exit was found. The disclosed Q2-2026 transfer was a 1.63% syndication within the Brookfield ecosystem and did not establish a control change. Neoen also sold individual Australian and French asset portfolios after the take-private, but those project-level disposals did not alter the canonical-company ownership conclusion.

responseSourceHealthCorrections: The response's 11% Americas share is a transparent 0.9 GW divided by 8.3 GW inference from the same direct disclosure, not a separately printed percentage.
The 85.4% figure includes passive co-investors alongside BGTF II and therefore is not represented as Brookfield's sole proprietary economic interest.
The 1.63% recipient is described only as a Brookfield Fund and remains not publicly identified.
The 468 MW North American figure is the sum of the directly disclosed 93 MW Fox Coulee and 375 MW El Llano assets; it is not treated as the complete Americas region.
